feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 10 September 2026 8:33am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 10 September 2026 at 8:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds for a time.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure system near Iceland, bringing frontal zones across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South 5 or 6, increasing occasionally 7 this morning, veering Southwest 4 to 6 this afternoon, then decreasing 4 or 5 this evening. Further veering West or Northwest overnight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, but slight in Liverpool Bay at first, becoming occasionally rough later this morning and early this afternoon, falling slight or moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Rain and drizzle, becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Northwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 around midday tomorrow, then backing South or Southwest through the afternoon. Increasing 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, then 5 or 6 overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first, building moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain or drizzle spread from the west overnight into Saturday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle later.
